grammar.title: 把字句：把 + 受詞 + 動詞
grammar.pattern: 主語 + 把 + 受詞 + 動詞 + 了／完／補語
grammar.explanation: 用「把」可以先說出你要處理的東西，再說你對它做了什麼。動詞後面常常要加「了」、「完」或方向、地點等補語，不能只用一個動詞。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ jiǎotàchē qí dào xuéxiào.
examples.gloss: I rode the bike to school.

examples.gloss: Please turn off the TV, I'm going to sleep.

grammar.title: 又……又…… (both... and...)
grammar.pattern: Subject + 又 + Adj/Verb 1 + 又 + Adj/Verb 2
grammar.explanation: 用「又……又……」放在兩個形容詞或動詞前面,表示兩個情況同時存在,像英文的 both... and...。注意兩邊的意思要一樣是好的,或一樣是不好的。

examples.hanzi: 這家店的麵又便宜又好吃。

examples.gloss: The noodles at this shop are both cheap and tasty.

grammar.title: 應該 — expressing what someone should do
grammar.explanation: 應該 (yīnggāi) goes before the verb to say what someone ought to do. To make it negative, put 不 before 應該: 不應該 means "shouldn't". It is often used with 我認為 to give an opinion, for example 我認為你應該早點睡。

examples.gloss: You should leave a bit earlier.
We should take the MRT there.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yīnggāi chī tài duō táng.
examples.gloss: You shouldn't eat too much sugar.

grammar.title: 跟 — doing something with someone
grammar.pattern: A + 跟 + B + 一起 + Verb
grammar.explanation: 跟 (gēn) links two people and means "with". It comes before the verb, and 一起 (together) is often added after it: 我跟他一起去。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn mèimei yìqǐ kàn diànshì.
examples.gloss: I watch TV with my little sister.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào gēn wǒmen yìqǐ qù ma?
examples.gloss: Do you want to go with us?

examples.pinyin: Tā gēn lǎobǎn yìqǐ qù cāntīng.
examples.gloss: He went to the restaurant with the boss.
